# @openlaunchsdk/launches (v1.22.1)

Launch Library 2 normalized resources and NASA provider. Install only the capabilities your application needs:

```sh
npm install @openlaunchsdk/launches
```

```ts
import { LaunchDataClient } from '@openlaunchsdk/launches';
const data = new LaunchDataClient();
const next = await data.launches.next();
```

LaunchDataClient builds a configured HTTP client. For finer control, construct LaunchesResource with HttpClient from @openlaunchsdk/core. No satellite.js or rocket simulation installed.

**Distribution:** generated by the monorepo build into `dist/esm`, `dist/cjs` and `dist/types`. The `openlaunch-sdk` umbrella remains the backwards-compatible umbrella package. Internal module subpaths are implementation details and not intended as stable public APIs.

Source: [kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk](https://github.com/kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk). MIT license. Flight/orbit calculations are research-grade, not safety qualified.
